passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: This management's discussion and analysis provides a review of the results of operations, key operating metrics and non-GAAP financial measures, and liquidity and capital resources of Block, Inc. on a historical basis and outlines the factors that have affected recent earnings, as well as those factors that may affect future earnings. The following discussion and analysis should be read in conjunction with the consolidated financial statements and the notes thereto included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K ("Form 10-K"). This section of this Form 10-K generally discusses fiscal 2025 compared to fiscal 2024. The comparison of the fiscal 2024 results with the fiscal 2023 results that are not included in this Form 10-K can be found in the "Management's Discussion and Analysis Results of Operations" section in the Company's fiscal 2024 Annual Report within Part II, Item 7 of Form 10-K, filed on February 24, 2025. The statements in this discussion regarding our expectations of our future performance, liquidity, and capital resources; our plans, estimates, beliefs, and expectations that involve risks and uncertainties; and other non-historical statements in this discussion are forward-looking statements. These forward-looking statements are subject to numerous risks and uncertainties, including, but not limited to, the risks and uncertainties described under Item 1A. Risk Factors and elsewhere in this Form 10-K. Our actual results may differ materially from those contained in or implied by any forward-looking statements. Overview We launched the Square ecosystem in February 2009 to enable businesses ("sellers") to accept card payments, a critical capability that had previously been inaccessible to many businesses. We have since expanded to provide sellers additional products and services and to give them access to a cohesive ecosystem of tools to help them start, run, and grow their businesses. Similarly, with Cash App, we have built an ecosystem of financial products and services to help consumers manage their money. Cash App now provides an ecosystem of commerce solutions, financial services, and bitcoin capabilities focused on helping consumers make their money go further by enabling customers to store, send, receive, spend, invest, BNPL, borrow, or save their money. In addition, our nascent ecosystems include TIDAL as well as Bitcoin, which includes businesses such as Proto and Bitkey. In 2025, we generated gross profit of $10.4 billion, up 17% year over year. Cash App generated gross profit of $6.3 billion in 2025, up 21% year over year, primarily driven by growth in Cash App Borrow. Square generated gross profit of $3.9 billion in 2025, up 9% year over year, driven by financial solutions, most notably Square Loans. In 2025, operating income was $1.7 billion and Adjusted Operating Income was $2.1 billion, compared to operating income of $892.3 million and Adjusted Operating Income of $1.6 billion in 2024. Net income attributable to common stockholders was $1.3 billion compared to net income attributable to common stockholders of $2.9 billion for the same period in 2024, and Adjusted EBITDA was $3.5 billion, an increase of 14% year

In addition, in the past, following periods of volatility in the overall market and the market price of a particular company’s securities, securities class action litigation has often been instituted against these companies. Such litigation could result in substantial costs and a diversion of our management’s attention and resources. Our Class A common stock is listed to trade on more than one stock exchange, and this may result in price variations between the exchanges. Our Class A common stock is listed for trade on the NYSE and as CDIs on the ASX. Dual-listing may result in price variations between the exchanges due to a number of factors. Our Class A common stock is traded in U.S. dollars on the NYSE and our CDIs are traded in Australian Dollars on the ASX. The two exchanges also have differing vacation schedules. Differences in the trading schedules, as well as volatility in the exchange rate of the two currencies, among other factors, may result in different trading prices for our Class A common stock on the two exchanges. credit_strengths.text: Operating cash flow covers debt service comfortably, with free cash flow after capex exceeding total interest-bearing debt, and the company holds a net cash position that materially exceeds reported borrowings, so liquidity and coverage metrics sit well inside investment-grade-like tolerances for this sector.

Gross leverage is modest relative to sector medians, and interest coverage remains adequate despite operating margin sitting below the sector median, reflecting a business mix weighted toward lower-margin payment and consumer financial services activity rather than high-margin software licensing.

key_risks.text: Disclosed risk factors highlight sensitivity to seller transaction volumes, customer spending and repayment ability, and bitcoin price fluctuations, all of which can pressure gross profit and credit-loss experience across Cash App Borrow and Square Loans, making earnings and cash generation more cyclical than the current net cash position implies.

Debt is represented by a single tagged bank facility, with no aggregate debt total or short-term borrowings separately tagged, so the reported debt figure may omit other facilities; refinancing and maturity concentration cannot be assessed from the disclosed maturity profile, which is a material gap for the credit view.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage and free cash flow to debt are strong, and the company carries net cash rather than net debt, so scheduled interest and principal on the tagged facility appear comfortably serviceable from recurring operating cash flow even if profitability moderates from current levels.

Shareholder distributions absorb most free cash flow, with buybacks exceeding free cash flow generated in the period, so debt reduction depends on continued operating cash generation rather than retained cash; this is manageable given the net cash position but limits deleveraging capacity if cash flow weakens.

overall_credit_view.text: The indicative financial risk profile is minimal, supported by net cash, modest gross leverage and strong cash conversion; operating income has improved sharply over the trend period, and the Altman zone is safe, though operating margin remains below the sector median, reflecting the payments and consumer finance mix.

Analyst judgement is that credit quality is solid but not without event risk: bitcoin and consumer credit exposures, convertible note-related equity volatility and incomplete debt tagging warrant monitoring, while the net cash cushion and recurring cash flow provide meaningful headroom against a moderate earnings downturn.

credit_strengths.text: 營運現金流足以輕鬆覆蓋債務償付，扣除資本開支後之自由現金流超過計息債務總額，而公司持有之淨現金狀況顯著高於所呈報借款，故流動性及覆蓋率指標均穩處於此行業中類投資級別之容忍範圍內。
總槓桿相對行業中位數而言屬溫和，而儘管營運利潤率低於行業中位數，利息覆蓋率仍維持足夠，反映業務組合側重於利潤率較低之支付及消費金融服務活動，而非高利潤率之軟件授權。

key_risks.text: 所披露之風險因素凸顯對賣方交易量、客戶支出及還款能力，以及比特幣價格波動之敏感度，此等因素均可能對毛利及Cash App Borrow與Square Loans之信貸虧損經驗構成壓力，令盈利及現金產生較目前淨現金狀況所隱含者更具周期性。
債務僅以單一標籤銀行融資額度呈列，並無債務總額或短期借款之獨立標籤，故所呈報債務數字可能遺漏其他融資額度；從所披露之到期結構無法評估再融資及到期集中度，此對信貸觀點而言屬重大缺口。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率及自由現金流對債務比率均強勁，且公司持有淨現金而非淨債務，故即使盈利能力自目前水平放緩，標籤融資額度之預定利息及本金似乎仍可從經常性營運現金流中輕鬆償付。
股東分派吸收大部分自由現金流，回購金額超過期內所產生之自由現金流，故債務削減取決於持續營運現金產生而非留存現金；鑑於淨現金狀況，此屬可管理，但若現金流轉弱，則限制去槓桿能力。

overall_credit_view.text: 指示性財務風險狀況為極低，受淨現金、溫和總槓桿及強勁現金轉換所支持；營運收入於趨勢期內大幅改善，而Altman區域為安全，儘管營運利潤率仍低於行業中位數，反映支付及消費金融之業務組合。
分析師判斷為信貸質素穩健但並非全無事件風險：比特幣及消費信貸風險敞口、可換股票據相關之股權波動性及不完整之債務標籤均值得監察，而淨現金緩衝及經常性現金流則為中度盈利下滑提供有意義之緩衝空間。
